bug_semantics: An authenticated user able to run a workflow can control the Edit Image node's Draw Text value. n8n line-wraps that value and passes it to gm.drawText(). gm 1.23.1 quotes the value as an MVG string and escapes double quotes, but does not first escape attacker-supplied backslashes. A crafted backslash can therefore neutralize gm's added escape before a quote, terminate the intended text primitive, and inject another MVG primitive that makes a blind outbound request or opens a local file.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable text-to-gm.drawText() flow is already present in the parentless public root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa. That object is a 257-file initial release import rather than the smallest source change. Public history contains no pre-root member commit or parent tree, so the true commit that first authored the vulnerable boundary cannot be recovered and the aggregate root is rejected as the BIC.
ai_marker: unavailable: the true smallest BIC commit object is absent. The only public origin boundary, aggregate root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa, has human author and committer Jan Oberhauser <jan.oberhauser@gmail.com>, message 'Initial commit to release', no parent header, and no trailer or AI marker. Those object signals cannot be projected onto the unavailable pre-public BIC.
evidence: The first-party advisory https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/security/advisories/GHSA-233r-fpgw-fx8x describes authenticated Draw Text MVG primitive injection causing blind SSRF or local-file access. Its structured affected/patched tables say <1.123.69/>=1.123.69, <2.33.4/>=2.33.4, and <2.34.1/>=2.34.1. Although its prose names older releases, `git grep -n -F 'const renderText' n8n@1.123.67 n8n@2.31.5 n8n@2.32.1 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` shows the unescaped `lines.join` statement in all three, so the structured boundaries are the real closure points.

Origin checks reject a false aggregate BIC: `git log --all --reverse -S'.drawText(' --format='%H %P %s' -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage.node.ts packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` returns only 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa as the first addition. At that root, `git grep` shows `const renderText = lines.join` followed by `.drawText(positionX, positionY, renderText)`. `git diff-tree --root --no-commit-id --name-only -r 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa | wc -l` returns 257, and `git cat-file commit` has no parent header. Thus the root is a parentless import boundary, not a decomposed smallest BIC; because the true BIC is unknown, `introducer_parent_absent` remains false rather than describing the aggregate root.

BIC-object AI check: `git cat-file commit 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa` shows tree 14eb29daec80dcdcadeda4386acb44e2bf831176, human author/committer Jan Oberhauser, and message 'Initial commit to release', with no trailers or AI marker. The object is only the rejected public import boundary, so no AI attribution is made from it or from any fix commit.

The disputed fix field is resolved in favor of the primary. `git show ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` directly doubles backslashes before gm serialization and restricts the font to the installed-font list. `git grep -n -F 'const renderText' a7dec6df87d2eaedffd22e7c8939804e350185a9 ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 -- packages/nodes-base/nodes/EditImage/EditImage.node.ts` shows the immediate parent still using plain `lines.join` and the commit using `replaceAll` backslash doubling. `git merge-base --is-ancestor ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 master` succeeds, making ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 the canonical mainline landing.

The primary's direct fix is also verified: `git show -s --format='%H %T %P %s'` shows ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 and c4488a956f3d48e53c5aa3cc6a99c5851e8b2009 have the identical tree 77033e2954d683a27c8ea0c6e32d3c8566a95907 and identical parent a7dec6df87d2eaedffd22e7c8939804e350185a9. The latter is the public PR-head object, while `git merge-base --is-ancestor c4488a956f3d48e53c5aa3cc6a99c5851e8b2009 master` fails because the landed mainline object is ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0.

The reviewer's 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 is a real 1.x closing backport, but not the canonical mainline fix. Path-limited ancestry logs identify 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 between n8n@1.123.68 and n8n@1.123.69, 0405fc550f55051f6c459252f5860fa78d27ab80 between n8n@2.33.3 and n8n@2.33.4, and 170cfc787015d352488f6b6403af07a74e95ca1d between n8n@2.34.0 and n8n@2.34.1. A single `git grep` across those six tags shows plain `lines.join` in every last vulnerable tag and `replaceAll` backslash doubling in every first patched tag. This verifies all release boundaries while distinguishing branch backports from fix_sha.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the failure to preserve the application/MVG quoted-string boundary, not generic use of GraphicsMagick. The public root already contains that mechanism, but history starts with a parentless 257-file release import; using that aggregate as the BIC, claiming its missing parent belongs to the unknown BIC, or attributing its human object metadata to the pre-public author would violate the protocol. The origin and BIC-only AI gates therefore remain blocked. On the sole primary/reviewer disagreement, both auditors found commits that close the sink, but they assigned different repository roles to them. The reviewer chose the 1.x backport 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 for both fix fields. The primary is correct: ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0 is the master-reachable canonical landing, while c4488a956f3d48e53c5aa3cc6a99c5851e8b2009 is its same-tree, same-parent public PR-head object; 3e4fb19caf73276a68b38d45d96b3da5baf7cab7 and the two 2.x commits are verified release-line backports. Consequently fix_sha is ca3d42d8386515cd9f044377a15a632cd09b62f0, direct_fix_sha is c4488a956f3d48e53c5aa3cc6a99c5851e8b2009, and the verdict stays BLOCKED solely on the unavailable smallest BIC lineage.
remaining_gap: The missing evidence is the pre-public source commit that first authored the Edit Image text-to-gm.drawText mechanism, its immediate parent tree, and that exact commit object. Public n8n history begins at the parentless aggregate root 9cb9804eeec1576d935817ecda6bd345480b97fa and exposes no member SHAs. Those materials are required to name the smallest BIC, verify vulnerable-line absence in its direct parent, and inspect AI evidence on the BIC itself.
